name: SenseNova-SI-1.2-InternVL3-8B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A spatial-reasoning SFT of OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B, identical tensor set (7.944B) and config (28 layers, 3584 hidden, 32768 context). Wins all eight benchmarks in the card's single HTML table, most of them by a wide margin: MindCube-Tiny 89.0 vs 41.5, VSI 69.6 vs 42.1, BLINK 69.4 vs 53.5, 3DSRBench 60.1 vs 44.3, ViewSpatial 58.8 vs 38.6, SITE 49.0 vs 41.1, MMSI 42.6 vs 28.0, EmbSpatial-Bench 77.7 vs 76.4. That last row (+1.3) is the only near-tie and is the honest read on how much is spatial-reasoning training versus how much of the eight-benchmark mean the training set covers. Third checkpoint in the SenseNova-SI line (1.1 and 1.3 already recorded); base is a ROW not a column. Licence Apache-2.0, repo created 2025-12-05. Confidence 0.5.
